result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d deepen humanity’s capacity for empathy.

So many of the world’s problems—conflict, inequality, cruelty, neglect—are made worse by the inability or unwillingness to genuinely understand what others are experiencing. If people could more consistently feel the weight of other people’s lives, not just intellectually but emotionally, I think societies would become kinder, fairer, and more willing to solve shared problems.

Empathy wouldn’t erase every difficulty, but it would change how we treat each other while we face them.
